goal: List, open, reuse and archive owner-scoped PDFs in the existing lesson editor modal without breaking existing links.

in: Company-owned versus platform-owned PDF library in existing three editor contexts
Private library open, draft reuse and non-destructive archive
Feature-local permission integration and focused validation
out: Physical deletion, replacement, restore UI and general file manager
Unrelated review/QA, auth redesign, tooling repairs, deployment and PR updates
changeBoundary: PDF library permissions and private route
Unified PDF modal and insertion/operation seams
Focused PDF tests and disposable harness

invariants.statement: Company A, company B and platform catalogs remain separate; every action rechecks current authority.
Original document metadata, bytes, associations and published content are retained; archive does not revoke existing lesson links.
No public storage URL or bare PDF identity grants bytes; learner access never grants library access.
Existing upload, explicit Save, selected text, caret and cancellation remain correct on directly affected PDF paths.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All active own-scope PDFs are searchable and reachable via pagination in three editor contexts (FR-001/002).
Open shows a private authorized PDF in a new tab without changing the editor (FR-003/004).
Reuse another lesson's same-owner PDF in a current draft, preserving selection/custom label and saved access without duplicating bytes (FR-005).
Confirmed archive hides/prevents new reuse, records actor/time and preserves existing saved or already-attached uses (FR-006/007).
Grant, denial, direct access, prerequisites, scoped admin and revocation follow existing tenant/platform authority boundaries (FR-003).
Accessible narrow/keyboard/localized modal states preserve text on cancel, failure and stale completion (FR-008/009).

regressionSurfaces: PDF modal selection/insertion and shared operation guard
Retained PDF lesson associations, draft save/copy and contextual delivery

qaScenarios.description: Three own-scope catalogs; search, >60 files, pagination, duplicates and empty results (B-01/02/15)
Open other-lesson PDF in a new tab; editor unchanged (B-03)
Three editors reuse selected/custom/default labels; exact settled caret, Save/reload and contextual access (B-06/07/08)
Grant/denial, owner isolation both directions, direct access and revocation (B-04/05)
Archive cancel/confirm/retry; old published/copied links retained (B-10/11/13)
Stale reuse after archive; pre-archive attachment Save; stale/cancelled/published target denial (B-09/12)
Existing upload positive/invalid/cancel path through expanded modal (B-16)

ownerApproval.decision: User explicitly replied sim to approval of linked architecture and scope on 2026-09-16; specs/007-pdf-library/approval.md

frameworkAlignment.referenceAssessment: No external reference project supplied. Existing upload supplies target-lock integration evidence; contextual delivery and PDF insertion supply compatibility contracts. Image/video libraries do not determine PDF ownership or pagination. Design-system reference supplies UI semantics only. Native Eloquent, small Services, write Actions, company Policy/Gates and existing platform Account authority are sufficient; no repository layering or identity redesign.
frameworkAlignment.boostAssessment: laravel/boost absent from installed metadata and composer.lock; no available Boost documentation tool. Optional project policy. Official versioned documentation consulted as fallback; no Boost invocation claimed.
